semiconductor_relevance: High — OKAYA, through its ITEC division, specializes in advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly in die bonding and sorting technologies.
summary: OKAYA, showcasing ITEC's innovative flip-chip die bonders and die sorters, is a key player in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With a focus on high-speed processing and cost efficiency, their equipment is designed to enhance production capabilities in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Japan: ITEC will be visiting Japan to promote their products directly to customers.
